Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi20XmlWriter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi20XmlWriter
public final class Dexpi20XmlWriter extends Object
Writes the native object/property/reference serialization introduced by DEXPI 2.0.
